paragraphs: Yehudah ben Yishmael; see there, Chullin 118b. His foot was chafed, and he went out in a sandal with a patch underneath: Jerusalem Bameh Ishah, halakhah 2. R. Yudan bar Yishmael was studying Torah; his cloak fell, and a snake guarded it against passersby taking it.
